channel.title: Positive.Energy guides
channel.description: Research-informed guides to more positive energy.

item.title: How to Boost Your Energy Naturally: 15 Science-Backed Habits
item.description: Tired all the time? Fifteen practical, research-backed habits for more physical, mental and emotional energy, without another coffee.

item.title: How to Think More Positively (Without Toxic Positivity)
item.description: Positive thinking isn't ignoring problems. Learn realistic optimism, how to catch thinking traps and reframe harsh thoughts, step by step.

item.title: The Science of Gratitude: 7 Practices That Actually Work
item.description: What research says about gratitude and wellbeing, plus seven practical gratitude exercises, from three good things to the gratitude visit.

item.title: 12 Fast Stress-Relief Techniques You Can Use Anywhere
item.description: Twelve quick, evidence-informed ways to calm down in minutes, from the physiological sigh to grounding, plus a plan for long-term stress resilience.

item.title: The Positive Energy Morning Routine (15, 30 or 60 Minutes)
item.description: A flexible, science-informed morning routine for energy and mood, with 15-, 30- and 60-minute versions you can actually keep.

item.title: How to Protect Your Energy: Boundaries, Drains and Recovery
item.description: Practical ways to protect your energy: spotting drains, setting boundaries kindly, dealing with draining people and recovering on purpose.

item.title: How to Build Resilience: 9 Evidence-Based Strategies
item.description: Resilience is a skill you can build. Nine strategies from psychology research to bounce back from setbacks and grow through challenges.

item.title: How to Beat the Afternoon Slump (Without More Coffee)
item.description: Why energy dips after lunch and 10 practical ways to beat the 2–3 p.m. slump at work or home.

item.title: How to Find Your Purpose: A Practical 5-Step Framework
item.description: Purpose isn't found in a flash; it's built. A practical framework using values, strengths, contribution and experiments to find direction.

item.title: Do Affirmations Work? What the Research Says (and How to Use Them)
item.description: The honest science on positive affirmations, why some backfire, and how to write affirmations that actually help.

item.title: Burnout: Signs, Causes and a Practical Recovery Plan
item.description: How to recognise burnout, what really causes it, and a step-by-step recovery plan for individuals and managers.

item.title: 10 Daily Habits of Happy People (Backed by Research)
item.description: Ten everyday habits that research links to greater happiness and life satisfaction, and how to build them one at a time.

item.title: Sleep for Energy: 10 Ways to Wake Up Refreshed
item.description: Practical, evidence-informed sleep habits to wake up with more energy, from light and timing to the bedroom environment.

item.title: How to Choose a Life Coach: Costs, Credentials and Red Flags
item.description: What life coaching is (and isn't), typical costs, credentials to look for, questions to ask and red flags, plus how to get matched for free.

item.title: How to Create a Positive Workplace Culture: 10 Practices for Leaders
item.description: Ten practical, evidence-informed ways leaders can build a positive, high-energy workplace culture, from psychological safety to recognition.

item.title: Mindfulness for Beginners: A Simple 7-Day Starter Plan
item.description: What mindfulness is, what the evidence says, and a gentle 7-day plan to start, with no apps or incense required.
